To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the outsourcing of business processes and the outsourcing of IT operations are two distinct phenomena that are not necessarily related to each other.

(a) the outsourcing of business processes has a positive impact on the business and IT alignment of the outsourcing organization; (b) the outsourcing of IT operations has a negative impact on the business-IT alignment of the outsourcing company.
the relationship between IT outsourcing and business and IT alignment is a positive one, but not as strong as one would have hoped.

the relationship between IT alignment and outsourcing.
the relationship between the business and IT alignment and the outsourcing of business processes and IT operations.
the relationship between IT outsourcing and business and IT alignment, and the role of IT governance in this context.
